agents.B: ArchB, action_mode='active_inference', affect='none', gate_policy='ungated' (default), default etas, seed=derive_seed(primary_seed, 0, 'agent'). Byte-identical constructor to EXP-FP-0010 make_B / EXP-FP-0011 run_B_arm. B's core (prototypes/architecture-b/agent.py, generative_model.py, active_inference.py) UNTOUCHED — the SEARCH intervention wraps agent.selector.select at the instance level in the driver; no canonical file is modified.

arms.B-AUG: ArchB on POMaze wrapped by the odometry wrapper (experiments/odom_wrapper.py, drive='true', reused VERBATIM — sha256 fe5c6464a94310ad1e09cc5de89f62c8ae990f76fddb3fff7989dd065d76b1c9 matches the EXP-FP-0011 receipt): native 6-channel obs + 2 additive scalar channels odom_qx/odom_qy (coarse position hash). observation_space passed to ArchB is the augmented space; env_name='pomaze+odom'.
arms.B-AUGSEARCH: BOTH interventions: POMaze wrapped by OdomWrapper (drive='true', verbatim) AND the driver-side count-bonus exploration wrapper. The bonus key function reads ONLY the 5 canonical pomaze fields (wall_n/s/e/w, beacon) — odom_qx/odom_qy are present in obs but never read by the SEARCH mechanism, so the AUG x SEARCH interaction cannot be driven by the search mechanism reading the disambiguation channel.
arms.B-BASE: ArchB on canonical POMaze v1.0.0, native 6-channel observation space, no wrappers. Baseline replication of EXP-FP-0011 B-BASE (same constructor, same episode count; fresh seeds).
arms.B-SEARCH: ArchB on canonical POMaze v1.0.0 + the driver-side count-bonus exploration wrapper ONLY (no odometry). Same constructor as B-BASE; the wrapper is attached after construction.

background: EXP-FP-0010-POMAZE-DIAG (2026-10-07) diagnosed arch-B on pomaze as EXPLORATION-dominant + REPRESENTATION-bound (obs aliasing 0.667, n_contexts=1, p_goal 0.133; random play hits the +1.0 goal 1/180 episodes; goal trials register transiently then wash out). EXP-FP-0011-ALIASING (2026-10-07, 6 fresh paired seeds) held the null: a position-disambiguating odometry channel did NOT unlock B (B-AUG p_goal 0.1556 vs B-BASE 0.1000, neither gate fired; B-SHUF kill arm indistinguishable from B-AUG — the sub-gate lift was extra-channel/exploration noise, not disambiguation). Mechanism lead recorded: 'representation can only bind once reward is found repeatedly — next resolving experiment pairs disambiguation with a systematic-search exploration intervention.' This experiment is that resolving experiment: a 2x2 factorial (disambiguation x systematic search) testing whether disambiguation helps ONLY once search finds reward repeatedly.

conditions.beta_rationale: beta=0.3 (reward units): at c=0 the +0.3 bonus dominates the small negative step-penalty predictions (drives novel state-actions first); at c=8 it is ~0.1, still meaningful but fading, so the learned value signal can take over once reward is found. Frozen; no tuning on the run data.
conditions.coverage_counts: c[(key, action)] accumulate across ALL 15 episodes of a run (one persistent agent per (arm, seed)); reset only at agent construction. Cumulative coverage pressure is the systematic-search mechanism.
conditions.determinism: G2: recompute (B-AUGSEARCH, seed[0]) unrounded mean_return at 1e-9; else VOID. The bonus is a deterministic function of the (obs, action) history.
conditions.episodes: 15 per (arm, seed); one persistent agent object per (arm, seed) across episodes (cross-episode learning accumulates, as in EXP-FP-0010/0011).
conditions.exploration_bonus: b(a) = beta / sqrt(1 + c[(key,a)]), beta = 0.3, added to the selector's predict_reward(a) (vhat) for the current tick's action selection only. Implementation: driver wraps agent.selector.select with a closure: orig_select(lambda a: vhat(a) + bonus(a), ehat, risk). The original selector (learned error tables, lambdas, mode) is otherwise untouched; the wrap is per-instance, in the driver file only.
conditions.g0_additivity: canonical files byte-identical before and after: experiments/envs/pomaze.py, experiments/env_interface.py, prototypes/architecture-b/agent.py, generative_model.py, active_inference.py (sha256 recorded in receipt). odom_wrapper.py reused verbatim (sha matches EXP-FP-0011 receipt).
conditions.key_definition: key(obs) = tuple(round(obs[f],3) for f in ('wall_n','wall_s','wall_e','wall_w','beacon')) — the 5 canonical pomaze obs fields carrying position information. EXCLUDES odom_qx/odom_qy (never read, even when present in AUG arms) and steps_left (time-varying). The identical key function runs in B-SEARCH and B-AUGSEARCH.
conditions.legitimacy_contract: The SEARCH mechanism uses ONLY the obs stream + chosen actions: no goal position, no maze walls, no absolute position, no env internals. Same contract as the odometry wrapper. It does NOT use the odom channel (see key_definition) — the AUG x SEARCH interaction is therefore not confounded by the search mechanism reading disambiguation.
conditions.paired: same 6 fresh primary seeds across all 4 arms; env seeds derive_seed(primary, ep, 'env'), agent init derive_seed(primary, 0, 'agent'), per-episode agent reset derive_seed(ep_seed, run_index, 'agent') — identical derivation to EXP-FP-0010/0011, so arms differ ONLY by intervention.

decision_rules.binding_after_search_descriptive: (i) goal-probe retention: for arms with goal probes, compare |rhat_at_trial - 1.0| vs |rhat_at_end - 1.0| (final-model re-evaluation of the goal-step obs) — does the reward head move toward 1.0 AND retain it in AUG+SEARCH? (ii) within-arm learning curve: p_goal episodes 7-14 vs 0-6 per arm. (iii) n_contexts trajectory per arm. (iv) per-seed correlation between goal-trial count and late-episode p_goal. All descriptive; no gates.
decision_rules.h_supported: BOTH interaction gates fire on the 6-seed aggregates: (a) interaction on p_goal: (p_AS - p_S) - (p_A - p_B) >= 0.15; AND (b) interaction on mean return: (ret_AS - ret_S) - (ret_A - ret_B) >= 0.5. Verdict: disambiguation helps ONLY once systematic search finds reward repeatedly (the mechanism lead is causally confirmed).
decision_rules.inconclusive: exactly one of (a)/(b) fires -> PARTIAL: reported honestly, no H verdict; mechanism follow-up required.
decision_rules.main_effects_descriptive: SEARCH main = mean(p_S, p_AS) - mean(p_B, p_A); AUG main = mean(p_A, p_AS) - mean(p_B, p_S); computed on p_goal and on mean return, with per-seed tables. No hard gates — descriptive.
decision_rules.manipulation_checks_descriptive: (i) coverage: distinct (key, action) pairs visited per (arm, seed) — expect SEARCH arms > BASE/AUG; (ii) p_goal_S vs p_goal_B — did the search intervention actually find more goals? (iii) mean applied bonus per tick vs mean |vhat| — is the bonus behaviorally meaningful or drowned? If (ii) fails, the interaction test is moot and reported as such.
decision_rules.null_holds: neither (a) nor (b) fires -> NULL HOLDS: no interaction — search helps or doesn't, independently of disambiguation (or neither helps). Recorded in research/negative_results.md; B's MATURITY.md annotated.

diagnostic_hypotheses.H_interaction: Disambiguation is USELESS without repeated reward (EXP-FP-0011) but becomes load-bearing once systematic search finds the goal repeatedly: the reward head can then bind the odom-resolved position to value. Predicts a positive AUG x SEARCH interaction on p_goal (>= 0.15) and mean return (>= 0.5): (AUG+SEARCH - SEARCH) > (AUG - BASE).
diagnostic_hypotheses.H_search_main: The count-bonus drives systematic coverage of the aliased obs-key space, raising goal-finding (p_goal_SEARCH > p_goal_BASE) and coverage counts vs BASE/AUG. Descriptive.
diagnostic_hypotheses.null: No interaction: the search intervention helps (or doesn't) independently of disambiguation; and/or the bonus fails to find reward at all, leaving the interaction test moot. Either way the mechanism lead is not confirmed.

envs.pomaze: v1.0.0, canonical, UNTOUCHED. Both wrappers are driver-side; env internals never read by the policy.

frozen_gates.G2_determinism: recompute (B-AUGSEARCH, seed[0]): unrounded mean_return match at 1e-9; else VOID.
frozen_gates.G3_receipts: hash-chained ndjson receipts/EXP-FP-0012-2X2-SEARCH.ndjson (kinds: preregistration, env_config, seed_result, verdict, determinism_check; prev_hash + receipt_hash; chain verified at end).

limitations: 15 episodes/arm/seed (matches EXP-FP-0010/0011). beta=0.3 is a frozen judgment call, not tuned. The count key is coarse (aliased obs keys, ~28 observed) — coverage is over the obs-key space, not true positions. Single env (pomaze); generalization untested. The interaction gates are on 6-seed aggregates; seed-level heterogeneity is reported but does not gate. CONSCIOUSNESS: UNRESOLVED — this experiment measures closed-loop returns and a representational/exploration intervention; no claims about conscious state. Donor provenance: n/a (no donor code; lab-native mechanisms only). Cognitive neutrality: the intervention is a reward-scale exploration bonus on the obs stream; no privileged-person machinery, no affect/persona content.
null_hypothesis: No AUG x SEARCH interaction: systematic search helps (or fails to help) independently of disambiguation, and/or the bonus does not raise goal-finding, so disambiguation remains inert as in EXP-FP-0011.
preregistered_metric: Per (arm, seed): per-episode returns, goal flags, steps-to-goal, stuck-step fraction, n_contexts, distinct (key,action) coverage, mean applied bonus. Goal probes (goal-step obs/action/ctx, rhat_at_trial, reward_at_trial, rhat_at_end re-evaluated with the final model). Aggregates: seed-mean mean_return and p_goal per arm across the 6 fresh seeds (per-seed values also reported). Decision rules as stated (interaction gates 0.15 p_goal / 0.5 return; floor-free since gates are on differences).
